These are preliminary maps derived from satellite radar and should be used as guidance only. Coloured pixels may include false positives, and their absence does not mean an absence of damage or flooding.
methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Cuba Hurricane Melissa: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2025

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Cuba Hurricane Melissa (Oct 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9**
- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9**
- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 29 October 2025, v0.9**
- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 29 October 2025, v0.9**

**More map details and files:** <https://sf.earthobservatory.sg/event/EOS-RS_202510_Cuba_Hurricane_Melissa>

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

resources.description:
EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM), highlighting areas in Cuba likely damaged by Hurricane Melissa, which made landfall on 29 Oct 2025 as a Category 3 storm. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (08 Jul 2025 to 24 Oct 2025) and after the event (30 Oct 2025).

EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT, Shapefile.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in Cuba due to Hurricane Melissa, which made landfall on 29 Oct 2025 as a Category 3 storm. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (28 Mar 2025 to 18 Oct 2025) and after the event (30 Oct 2025).
